design.concept: A reading-first workspace for the collaborator's own expenses. The main scene keeps the status-filtered list on the left and, on the right, the selected expense read like a memo (identity, decisive facts, description, trail), with the send or resend block at the very end. Registering a new expense and correcting a rejected one are side tasks that open on demand as back-able scenes.

views.purpose: Main scene. List of expenses with status filter, next to the selected expense's detail and the send/resend decision block.
Form to register a new expense (saved as draft). Returns to the main scene, where the new expense is open in the detail.
Form to correct a rejected expense, prefilled from the open expense. Returns to the main scene after saving, where the resend action waits.

design.decisions: Followed the readAndDecide template: the detail reads downward (category and date as identity, status chip, the amount large, description, then the trail with resubmission flag, payment date and the manager's rejection reason in a contextual feedback). The send or resend block is a sibling after the card, never sticky or beside it. The block locks while running, shows errors above the buttons in body color, and ends in a calm statement. Departure: the list stays visible beside the record, because the list is the primary section and opening an expense replaces nothing. The record comes from the list, so no id is typed. The two forms are scenes through the scene host with back; the page title stays in one h1, scene titles name each view and differ from button labels. Status filter is native toggle chips (aria-pressed); the list uses ml-data-table without sorting so row indices match the data, and 'show more' appends the next page. Currency is shown as BRL, because the contract only says money. The proof-of-expense upload is left out because the shared has no state to hold a file. A missing proof will come back as a backend error shown above the submit button.
